description: This is a Zephyr RTOS-based C source file implementing a Modbus TCP server with GPIO-controlled LEDs, custom Modbus function handling, and network socket management.

methods.name: custom_handler
methods.description: Handles custom Modbus function calls, processes request, and prepares response.

methods.name: init_leds
methods.description: Initializes GPIO pins connected to LEDs.

methods.name: coil_rd
methods.description: Reads the state of a coil (LED) at a given address.

methods.name: coil_wr
methods.description: Writes a state to a coil (LED) at a given address.

methods.name: holding_reg_wr
methods.description: Writes a value to a holding register.

methods.name: server_raw_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling raw Modbus messages received by the server.

methods.name: modbus_tcp_reply
methods.description: Sends a Modbus TCP reply to the client.

methods.name: modbus_tcp_connection
methods.description: Handles a Modbus TCP connection, receives request, and sends response.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up the server, initializes LEDs, and handles incoming connections.
